articles.summary: Investor's Business Daily: Fidelity OTC Builds Wealth Buying Stocks With 'Durable' Profit. You won't find one-hit wonders in top mutual fund Fidelity OTC Portfolio (FOCPX). To earn a spot in Christopher Lin's top mutual fund, earnings need to grow fast every year. "I affectionately call my strategy 'durable growth at a reasonable price,' or DARP," said Lin, who has piloted Fidelity OTC solo since 2019.
